from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentExtraction(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single court document to determine if it matches the target cause of action."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the document (e.g., '《判决文书 25》')")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action (案由) explicitly stated in the document text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentExtraction]
